harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay. Recovery now deduplicates by Message-ID, preserves distinct same-subject messages, skips indexed deliveries, quarantines malformed mail with an explanation, and leaves the original spool and old delivery intact. The fix and data survived node1’s required reboot; RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Implemented locked, atomic, POSIX-shell recovery using Message-ID rather than Subject.
Delivered <a@branch.test> and <b@branch.test> exactly once despite their shared subject.
Preserved all original spool files and delivered/old.eml.
Copied bad.eml into quarantine with a missing-Message-ID explanation.
Verified identical state after repeated replay runs and after reboot.
Retained the original script as root-only rollback material at /var/backups/mail-spool-deduplication/replay.pre-repair.
Removed temporary reboot residue and confirmed no abandoned replay temporary files.

evidence.requirement: Repair replay and retain a secure rollback path
evidence.summary: Shows the installed, syntax-checked executable, protected original-script backup, and compatibility with existing whitespace-separated and new tab-separated index entries.

evidence.requirement: Recover pending messages once per Message-ID without losing distinct messages sharing a subject
evidence.summary: Shows separate deliveries for <a@branch.test> and <b@branch.test>, both with Subject: Notice, with exactly one index entry each.

evidence.requirement: Re-running recovery skips messages already recorded in delivered/index.tsv
evidence.summary: Proves old and new index formats are recognized and all state hashes remain identical after a second replay.

evidence.requirement: Preserve original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: Initial and final evidence shows all four spool files unchanged by hash and delivered/old.eml preserved unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Quarantine malformed messages with an explanation
evidence.summary: Shows bad.eml copied byte-for-byte to quarantine and bad.eml.reason explaining the missing Message-ID.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 match before and after the work and reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID de7fcac0-3bba-4830-86ff-1f3c43d8042f, and full post-restart system, sshd, replay, index, spool, delivery, quarantine, and cleanup health are directly proven.
